name: live_two_cells_worldspaces
description: Two peers in two worldspaces. Both start in Doc Mitchell's house. The host leads the party out into Goodsprings (WastelandNV). The guest goes to the Old Mormon Fort exterior cell (FreesideOldMormonFort, worldspace FreesideFortWorld) and hits a person there. `coop cell` puts the guest in the fort's worldspace, and `coop teleport` moves it next to the person (5973, 2042). Outdoors the live layer files each player under its worldspace, so the host must see the guest in FreesideFortWorld (1235278) while the guest stands in the fort cell (1235411). Each peer must own and run the people of its own cell, the host must count the guest's people as the guest's, and neither peer may mirror the other cell's people. After the split the host sets CG03TestValue and the guest asks the host to set DemoVatsCameraGlobal: both values must reach both peers, and the shared hash must agree. A `coop hit NAME 1` line hits that person once for 1 point. The line also names the person, so the simulator loads it (the viewer loads the whole cell). Headless only: the viewer bot has no `coop cell` verb.
